title: 微信登录
WeChat sign-in
desktop_help: 用手机微信扫描电脑上的二维码。
Scan the code on your computer using WeChat on your phone.
phone_email: 手机上请使用下方邮箱登录。微信扫码登录目前支持电脑端。
Use email to sign in on this phone. WeChat QR sign-in is currently available on a computer.
first_link: 首次使用微信，请验证你在小狗拼豆铺使用的邮箱；已有账号请使用原邮箱。
For your first WeChat sign-in, verify the email you use with PinDou Puppy. Use your existing email if you already have an account.
confirm_link: 将微信绑定到这个账号
link_preserves_account: 绑定后，仍使用这个账号的图纸、时长钱包和积分。
Your patterns, time wallet and loyalty points stay with this account.
wechat_not_configured: 微信登录暂未开放，请使用邮箱登录。
WeChat sign-in is not available yet. Please use email.
wechat_flow_expired: 这次微信登录已过期或来自另一个浏览器，请重新登录。
This WeChat sign-in expired or belongs to another browser. Please start again.
wechat_flow_used: 这次登录已处理，可以继续访问；如尚未登录，请返回登录页重试。
This sign-in has already been processed. Continue, or return to sign-in if needed.
wechat_provider_unavailable: 微信登录服务暂时无法连接，请重试或使用邮箱登录。
We cannot reach WeChat sign-in right now. Try again or use email.
wechat_cancelled: 微信登录未完成，请重试或使用邮箱登录。
WeChat sign-in was not completed. Try again or use email.
wechat_identity_invalid: 微信登录验证未通过，请重新登录。
We could not verify this WeChat sign-in. Please start again.
wechat_binding_conflict: 该微信或邮箱已有其他绑定，请使用原账号登录。
This WeChat or email already has a different link. Please sign in with your original account.
wechat_origin_invalid: 请从当前网站重新发起登录。
Please start sign-in again from this website.
wechat_return_invalid: 返回地址无效，请从网站页面重新登录。
The return address is invalid. Please sign in from a page on this website.
